title: Boss: The Urgent Hotfix
story: You are halfway through a feature when production breaks. Park your work, fix main, and come back.
goal: Stash your work, switch to main, commit a fix with a message containing "hotfix", return to feature/ui and restore your work.

tests.label: Your work in progress is back

hints: git stash puts uncommitted work on a shelf.
stash, switch main, edit+commit, switch feature/ui, stash pop.

Run:
git stash
git switch main
echo 'v2' > app.py
git add app.py
git commit -m "hotfix prod"
git switch feature/ui
git stash pop
socratic: Which command shows you the evidence you need?
explain: In one sentence: what was the cause, and how did you fix it?
